svg.text: Half-size (30-column) breadboard; fits the same way on a full-size one. Holes are named column + row, e.g. j25.
RJ50 breakout (plugs into the desk's free port)
With USB-C hanging off the left, the top pin row should read
5V G 3.3 4 3 2 1 0 (left to right). If your board's
labels differ, stop and tell me before wiring.
Wire with the RJ50 unplugged, then meter vs GND on USB power:
chip pin 14 ≈ 5 V, chip pin 1 ≈ 3.3 V, hole b10 (GPIO4) ≈ 0 V.
